Proposal Format and Content The offeror should submit the following volumes for its proposal in the below specified format(s) and page limitations: 2 Volume Title Maximum Page Limit Volume I Technical Approach & Execution Capability 10 Pages Volume II Creative Portfolio & Reel Samples 5 Pages + Up to 3 Video Links Volume III Past Performance Questionnaire (not limited) Volume IV Price Proposal No Limit Sound or video files shall not be embedded or submitted in any of the proposal files. Embedded sound or video files will not be read. Each Offeror is responsible for ensuring proposal files are free of viruses. Narrative files shall be submitted in a PDF format, and the price build-up shall be submitted in an Excel format with clearly visible formulas with no hidden rows or columns. The narrative or main text of each volume must be in Times New Roman font, size 12. The offeror may use other font types and or sizes for charts, illustrations, tables, graphs, figures, and technical scenario products if the font is clearly legible. The Offeror shall use margins of at least one inch on all four sides of each page. Proprietary statements and page numbers may be printed in the margins. Pages shall be numbered sequentially. Pages shall be 8.5 x 11 inches. The following documents will not count towards the page limitations: cover sheet, cover letter, table of contents, acronym list, and the DD Form 254. In describing the approach, Offerors must provide a schedule their plan to manage the accelerated workflow required to create both the 5-part series and the 15 minute film simultaneously. The Offeror shall include a Gantt-chart and a Schedule that demonstrates how field photography, production schedules, and post-production assets for all deliverables will fit within the 6-month timeline to ensure that the final deliverable will be delivered on time. Note that the Government requires 15-business-day Government review cycles. Volume II Creative Portfolio & Reel Samples Offerors must submit a narrative to describe: their portfolio and a portfolio of work that demonstrates their capabilities in both long-form documentary, not to exceed 15 minutes in length and short-form self- contained documentary narratives, not to exceed 5 minutes in length.
